Container.Name: cinema-watch
Container.Overview: Ticket hunts for Italian cinemas (UCI, The Space, Webtic cinemas and 18Tickets): Telegram alerts with the seat map when showings come out or good seats free up. Hunts, cinemas and settings are managed from the web UI, which is in Italian.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Configuration, state, seat maps, history and log. On start the container gives it to PUID:PGID.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the data folder and runs the app. 99 is nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the data folder and runs the app. 100 is users on Unraid.

Config.Name: UI_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Web UI password. Empty: no password.

Config.Name: TRUST_PROXY
Config.Description: 1 when a reverse proxy in front sets X-Forwarded-For. Only needed with a password, for the per-IP login lockout.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_TOKEN
Config.Description: Bot token, if not set from the web UI. The web UI value wins.

Config.Name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
Config.Description: Main chat, if not set from the web UI. The web UI value wins.
